parameters.name: AdminList
parameters.description: The updated list of administrators. Separate multiple administrators with commas (,). You can specify up to three administrators.

parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description: The data center. It must be the same as the data center specified in the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) call. Valid values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

parameters.name: GroupInfo
parameters.description: The updated extended information of the group. The information can be up to 32 KB in length.

parameters.name: ModifyAdmin
parameters.description: Specifies whether to modify the group administrators.

parameters.name: ModifyInfo
parameters.description: Specifies whether to modify the extended information of the group.
